chronology.selectionCriterion: Lowest all-game 2024 margin MAE; exact ties favor stronger regularization.
chronology.availability: Use each frozen baseline cutoff and its original result availability delay; reconstruct and verify the exact training snapshot hash.
chronology.holdoutPolicy: 2025 and 2026 outcomes are not used to fit or select this challenger. Baseline 2025 results had already been inspected before the fixed challenger design was declared.

units.method: Attempt-weighted ridge: rate = league mean + offense effect - defense effect; common zero-centered priors.
units.pass: Reported net passing yards per reported passing attempt. Completion-attempt counts supply attempts; sacks are not added to dropbacks.
units.rush: Reported rushing yards per reported rushing attempt. NCAA box rushing can include sacks, kneels and team-only attempts; this is not designed-run efficiency.
units.passRate: Reported passing attempts / (reported passing attempts + reported rushing attempts), pooled only over games with both valid counts.
units.coverage: Usable positive-attempt games / eligible completed FBS-or-FCS opponent games. Zero attempts do not produce a rate.
units.adjustment: Positive means stronger for offense and defense. Offense adjusted rate = league mean + effect; defense adjusted rate = league mean - effect.
units.limitations: Uncalibrated descriptive challenger; no venue, game-state or personnel adjustment. Attempts within games are dependent. Missing boxes and disconnected schedules limit comparisons; ridge anchors disconnected components to a shared prior, not observed cross-component evidence.

definitions.missing: Any missing required unit or pass tendency produces exactly zero correction and the unchanged frozen baseline distribution.
definitions.winner: Probability above 0.5 picks home; below 0.5 picks away; exact 0.5 gets half credit. Actual ties excluded from probability metrics.
definitions.distribution: Translate each game’s existing frozen score-margin simulation by the fitted residual correction; retain original interval width. Seeded original score ties are represented by uniform jitter in (-0.5,0.5), matching baseline tie decisions exactly; new threshold ties receive half weight. Totals unchanged.
definitions.calibration: No probability or interval recalibration. Baseline simulator assumptions remain uncalibrated.

limitations: Reconstructed from corrected final archives, not archived pregame source responses. Publication times and historical revisions remain unknown.
One untouched holdout season cannot establish stability across many independent seasons.
Week blocks preserve within-week dependence but do not fully capture repeated teams across weeks or training/selection uncertainty.
Box passing/rushing definitions include NCAA sack/kneel accounting; these are not true dropback or designed-run efficiency.
meta.fingerprintAlgorithm: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify(parsed values); source code contents are hashed as JSON strings. The summary fingerprint excludes its own field.

fit.scaling: Root mean square about zero, fitted using eligible training rows only; no mean subtraction.
fit.objective: sum((actualMargin - baselineMargin - scaledFeatures * beta)^2) + lambda * sum(beta^2)

training.evaluation: In-sample descriptive fit; not promotion evidence.

bootstrap.block: All games sharing the frozen season and Monday prediction cutoff are resampled together.
bootstrap.limitation: Preserves within-week dependence only. Repeated teams across weeks, corrected archive revisions, coefficient estimation and model selection uncertainty are not fully represented.
